mapper.select: SELECT pav.attr_id, pav.attr_name, pav.attr_value FROM pms_product_attr_value pav INNER JOIN pms_attr pa ON pa.attr_id = pav.attr_id WHERE pav.spu_id = #{spuId} AND pa.catelog_id = #{catalogId} AND pa.search_type = 1 ORDER BY pav.attr_sort ASC

SELECT pag.attr_group_name, pa.attr_name, pav.attr_value FROM pms_product_attr_value pav INNER JOIN pms_attr pa ON pa.attr_id = pav.attr_id INNER JOIN pms_attr_attrgroup_relation aar ON aar.attr_id = pav.attr_id INNER JOIN pms_attr_group pag ON pag.attr_group_id = aar.attr_group_id WHERE pav.spu_id = #{spuId} AND pa.attr_type = 1 AND pag.catelog_id = #{catelogId} ORDER BY pag.attr_group_name, pav.attr_sort ASC
